summary: Lincoln County, MT tower on the Kootenai NF, 13 miles west of Yaak: a 30-foot pole L-4 tower from 1940, gone in the 1970s. No source describes the site today.

facts.status_note: Gone in the 1970s according to firelookout.com; the state list also marks it gone.

events.note: Source gives only the decade ('Gone 1970s'); 1970 stands in for the 1970s, not a dated event

evidence.supports: state list marks the Lincoln County tower gone
a second Thunder Mountain lookout exists in Ravalli County and is a separate site
Ravalli County site had a 30-foot pole L-4 tower, built 1940 and destroyed 1975
evidence.quote: This 30' pole L-4 tower, built in 1940, was destroyed in 1975.

sources.title: Thunder Mtn. Fire Lookout Tower (Ravalli County page)

notes_for_editor: Thin evidence: two firelookout.com pages and the state list. Two searches and a few reads turned up no staffing, fire or NRHP source for this site, and no source describes what remains there. Do not conflate with the Ravalli County Thunder Mountain (firelookout.com/mt/thundermtn.html, Bitterroot NF, 1940-1975). That page has the same '30' pole L-4 tower, built 1940' wording and a list of lookout personnel, but those names and dates belong to the Ravalli site only. The brief record (tower, gone, Lincoln County, 48.80818 -116.00056) matches the Lincoln page. The 1970 date in events is a placeholder for the decade.
